clean_body: We must band together to fight like hell for reproductive freedoms to be preserved and protected as the law of the land. = | Peter, Yesterday we received the devastating news that the Supreme Court is overturning the landmark Roe v. Wade decision, denying women the right to an abortion at the federal level. While I am devastated and scared about what this will mean for thousands of women across the nation, as the Executive Director of the Maryland Women’s Law Center and the former Board President of Planned Parenthood Maryland, I know exactly what next steps we need to take in Maryland. We must band together to fight like hell for reproductive freedoms to be preserved and protected as the law of the land. And now more than ever, it is critically important we elect pro-choice Democratic governors who will codify the right to an abortion in the state constitution and provide access to women across the country who are deterred from obtaining an abortion by restrictive GOP trigger laws. One of the best ways you can help fight back against the horrendous news out of the Supreme Court this morning is to support Democrats running for statewide office who will protect reproductive rights at all costs. | | I’ve spent my entire career fighting on behalf of women’s rights to reproductive healthcare and freedom of choice. And, it’s not lost on me the disparate impact this regressive decision will have on low-income women, women of color, and survivors of sexual violence. If elected as Lieutenant Governor, enshrining the right to an abortion in our state constitution will be a top priority. Yesterday, John and I joined Pro-Choice Maryland Action for a rally against the misguided and disastrous Supreme Court decision. In a King-Siri administration, that commitment to advocacy and action on behalf of human rights everywhere will never waver. = = = | = In solidarity, Michelle Siri P.S. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5bv5ckp3rsl1n6jngqo84vnbv6nvnq6pdfi7880_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chhm9oj4cph2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z897cqkucj4fm9lr8b2n4f801qu119rliigro9mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chhm9oj4cph2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds. The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that. The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training? That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. name: Peter Franchot
subject: My reaction to Roe v. Wade
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
In case you missed it yesterday, I just wanted to make sure you saw my reaction regarding the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is an attack on women, and we must make our voices heard at the ballot box. As Governor, I’ll fight to protect and expand access to abortion care at the state level. Under my watch, I’ll make sure Maryland forever remains a state which protects a woman’s right to choose.
We can’t risk getting outspent by a Republican opponent that would fight to take away abortion rights in Maryland. If you are able, will you chip in to make sure our movement has the resources we need to win this race? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roevwade_franchot?amount=20.22&refcode=kicker]
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]
Forwarded Message Below:
This is a dark day for America. The Supreme Court has just ruled to overturn Roe v. Wade in a stunning reversal of decades of legal precedent. Abortion is now outlawed in at least 26 states, and the right to choose has been taken away for millions of women across the country.
Like many of you, I am outraged by this decision. This is an attack on women, and it will disproportionately affect our minority communities and those who are economically disadvantaged.
It is now more urgent than ever that we protect and expand access to abortion care at the state level. As Governor, I’ll fight to enshrine the right to an abortion into the state constitution, ensure that healthcare providers cover abortion services, and ensure that undocumented Marylanders have access to safe, full care. Abortion is healthcare, and everyone deserves the right to choose.

As your Comptroller, I’ve been an unapologetic pro-choice advocate. In 2021, I proudly joined activists at Lawyers Mall in Annapolis to rally for abortion rights. And earlier this year, I urged the Governor to immediately release $3.5 million restricted in the Fiscal Year 2023 operating budget to provide funding for abortion care training programs. I repeat the same call today.
Abortion is now outlawed in nearby states like West Virginia, Ohio, Tennessee, and Kentucky. I firmly believe that our state should be prepared to step up and provide these critical healthcare services to women who need them.
We cannot let the anti-abortion extremists take us further backwards. Let this day be a call to action. We must make our voices heard at the ballot box. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roevwade_franchot?amount=20.22&refcode=kicker]

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za15otij28ipm26355cvd0nb5msp4jld7jrbeg1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chhm9oj4cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zitgccekn6sq3o678cjva0a776a77ua40sp5k258_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chhm9oj4cjh2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Peter, **The Supreme Court just struck down Roe v. Wade, saying that Americans do not have a constitutional right to an abortion.**

As a physician who has sat by the bedsides of patients who are seeking abortion care, I can tell you without hesitation that this will cost lives. Pregnant people living in states with extreme bans on abortion rights will be forced to give birth. Others will face the same fate if anti-abortion extremists in other states have their way.

**But our fight isn't over.**

The U.S. Senate must codify abortion rights into law and we must commit to electing U.S. Senators who will fight for these rights. And here in Pennsylvania, where people can still legally seek an abortion, we must defend their rights. **[That's why electing Josh Shapiro and John Fetterman is more important than ever, and why I'm asking you to split a contribution to their campaigns today. clean_body: We won’t go back. | Peter, The Supreme Court just struck down Roe v. Wade, saying that Americans do not have a constitutional right to an abortion. As a physician who has sat by the bedsides of patients who are seeking abortion care, I can tell you without hesitation that this will cost lives. Pregnant people living in states with extreme bans on abortion rights will be forced to give birth. Others will face the same fate if anti-abortion extremists in other states have their way. But our fight isn't over. The U.S. Senate must codify abortion rights into law and we must commit to electing U.S. Senators who will fight for these rights. And here in Pennsylvania, where people can still legally seek an abortion, we must defend their rights. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = = = If Republican legislators like Doug Mastriano hadn't been stopped by Governor Wolf and Democrats like me, Pennsylvania would have already passed the most extreme anti-abortion laws in the country. We need Josh Shapiro in the governor’s office to protect Pennsylvanians’ right to an abortion. And we must elect more Democratic Senators who will stand up for abortion rights in the Senate and codify this into law for all Americans. Once and for all. To do that, we must elect John Fetterman to the Senate this November to defend reproductive justice. There's no question that this is a dark day. And for many of us, while we are distraught and saddened by this ruling we also aren’t surprised. We’ve known this was the outcome Republicans have been working towards and now we have to fight back. There's never been a more important time to take action and elect leaders who will fight for our rights. Both of these races are extremely competitive, and every dollar is crucial to determining our future. = Now is the time to show that we will never go back. We cannot just sit back and let this happen.

Since the leak from the Supreme Court on Roe v. Wade, dozens of pro-life pregnancy centers across the country have been vandalized and attacked with fire bombs by far-left thugs.

**The response from Democrats?_Absolute silence._**

To date, no Democrats have condemned these shocking displays of violence, and Joe Biden’s Department of Justice hasn’t lifted a finger to hold the perpetrators accountable.

Just imagine the outrage from the Left and the mainstream media if it was their agenda under attack.

# **_ED THELANDER STATEMENT ON RECENT GUN LEGISLATION_**
"I find it ironic that, on the same day the United States Supreme Court issued a ruling that bolsters the “shall not be infringed” language in the 2nd Amendment, Congress took a significant step toward further restrictions of gun ownership rights in America.

I'm a firm believer that we do not need new gun laws - we just need to enforce those common-sense gun laws that are already on the books. We also desperately need to address the growing mental health crisis. I do support putting more resources into that effort, and am glad to see increased funding for child and family mental health services included in the bill.

However, I find the “red flag law” component of the bill to be of real concern. Under that provision, lawfully-owned firearms could be seized before the accused has an opportunity to contest the accusations against them. This lack of due process is clearly unconstitutional. While the decision whether to implement these laws is left to the states, the efforts will be funded at the federal level. This is very troubling. My opponent, Representative Chellie Pingree, has consistently advocated for the imposition of federal “red flag” laws, recently touting the “Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order Act”, which she co-sponsored.

What is most needed now are the following action-items: A serious effort to ensure that the laws that are already on the books are followed and enforced; Increased focus on the growing mental health crisis; Implementation of safety protocols in schools around the nation that protect our children in the same manner we protect all other state and federal buildings.

I became a deputy sheriff after watching an active shooter drill at my kids' school and realized I could help. I want to advance constructive solutions that don't involve creating restrictions on constitutional rights. That's a slippery slope. It's clear that focusing on the mental health component, and earnestly enforcing existing gun laws will yield the greatest results."

– _Ed Thelander is the Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District and resides in Bristol_

clean_body: ED THELANDER STATEMENT ON RECENT GUN LEGISLATION | | | | | | | | | ED THELANDER STATEMENT ON RECENT GUN LEGISLATION "I find it ironic that, on the same day the United States Supreme Court issued a ruling that bolsters the “shall not be infringed” language in the 2nd Amendment, Congress took a significant step toward further restrictions of gun ownership rights in America. I'm a firm believer that we do not need new gun laws - we just need to enforce those common-sense gun laws that are already on the books. We also desperately need to address the growing mental health crisis. I do support putting more resources into that effort, and am glad to see increased funding for child and family mental health services included in the bill. However, I find the “red flag law” component of the bill to be of real concern. Under that provision, lawfully-owned firearms could be seized before the accused has an opportunity to contest the accusations against them. This lack of due process is clearly unconstitutional. While the decision whether to implement these laws is left to the states, the efforts will be funded at the federal level. This is very troubling. My opponent, Representative Chellie Pingree, has consistently advocated for the imposition of federal “red flag” laws, recently touting the “Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order Act”, which she co-sponsored. What is most needed now are the following action-items: A serious effort to ensure that the laws that are already on the books are followed and enforced; Increased focus on the growing mental health crisis; Implementation of safety protocols in schools around the nation that protect our children in the same manner we protect all other state and federal buildings. I became a deputy sheriff after watching an active shooter drill at my kids' school and realized I could help. I want to advance constructive solutions that don't involve creating restrictions on constitutional rights. That's a slippery slope. It's clear that focusing on the mental health component, and earnestly enforcing existing gun laws will yield the greatest results." – Ed Thelander is the Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District and resides in Bristol | "CLICK TO DONATE" | | Ed Thelander is a United States Navy veteran. Peter,

That was my reaction yesterday morning – I’m thanking God that a 5-4 majority on the U.S. Supreme Court made the right decision and overturned Roe v. Wade.

This is a historic moment in our nation’s history.

**Finally, after nearly 50 years and millions of precious lives lost, states are now fully empowered to limit and even BAN abortion to protect the unborn!**

While we are celebrating this victory for life, this fight is far from over.
[**Will you step up to help DEFEND THE DEFENSELESS at this critical time?**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fafa690e6b176f77/d10e65a8bc346786c3d6b838967d376c/33013)
Pro-abortion extremists in Democrat-run states across the country are doubling down on their assault against life. They want to create abortion destinations, where even horrific late-term procedures right up until the moment of birth will be legal.

_And D.C. Democrats are already talking about expanding the Supreme Court and packing it with far-left activist judges!_

We cannot let up in this fight until EVERY precious unborn child is protected.

**I’m proud to support a complete ban on abortion, here in Alabama and across America.**

Now is the time to ramp up our efforts. I hope you’ll join me.

[**Please make a $5, $10, $25, or $50 special contribution today.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fafa690e6b176f77/91d9b6e7f54f83bac3d6b838967d376c/33013)

| Hi Peter, Yesterday, we heard the most damning decision from the Supreme Court. Roe v. Wade, which has been settled law for nearly 50 years, has been overturned. Abortion access is now left to the states to decide, with 13 states already enacting so-called trigger laws, which point blank outlaw abortion, regardless of the fetus’ viability or the mother’s health. This decision, which should be left to a woman and her doctor, has been stolen from millions of people by a conservative, extremist, court and is **not** representative of what the country wants. I don’t say that to scare anyone, but to realistically say where we’re at as a country. Now is not the time to despair, but to make a plan for action. We are each able to fight back against this decision. The number one thing we can do is to vote for pro-choice Democrats at every level of government. I know you’re tired of hearing the same refrain of “NOW is the most important time to vote”, but now that abortion access is left to decide, it’s absolutely vital that we keep and expand pro-choice majorities in ever state, local, and federal office. Dear Friend,

**Something unusual happened in America this week; the Supreme Court made a series of sensible decisions that millions of Americans find refreshing.**

On Tuesday, in a case involving two families from Maine, the court ruled that public money could indeed be spent providing a religious education.

As every American school child used to know, the First Amendment prohibits the government from endorsing any particular religion. However, in a 6-3 ruling, the justices decided that permitting public money to go to a religious school did not constitute any such endorsement.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=984213d1ae&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| **On Thursday things got even more interesting. **In New York, officials had introduced a permit-scheme for anyone wanting to carry guns outside their home. In doing so, these officials had decided to give themselves broad authority to deny permits for almost any reason. This, too, the Court ruled was not on.

**The Second Amendment states that “****the right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed.”** In his ruling on the New York case, Judge Clarence Thomas wrote “We know of no other constitutional right that an individual may exercise only after demonstrating to government officers some special need”.

**All this proved a little too much for President Biden, who took to twitter to complain about it:**
---
|
---
| **Then came the biggest ruling of the lot yesterday when the Supreme Court ruled on Dobbs Vs Jackson Women’s Health Organization.** The justices found in favor of Mississippi’s right to enact pro-life legislation. They sided with the argument that such decisions should be returned to each state. Mr. President didn't approve of that either:
---
|
---
| We are so used to having a left-leaning Court that the idea that the Court might make any of these decisions seems odd. To have three rulings in a single week is extraordinary.

The implications of this week go far beyond the merits of these individual cases.

**For decades, leftist lawyers in America have used the courts to advance their agenda.** And often, it has to be said, the Supreme Court helped them along the way. Federal power was significantly, and deliberately, extended by Chief Justice Earl Warren, for example.

**Now that the Court has a more balanced range of justices sitting on the bench, we are starting to see some of the judicial and federal aggrandizement of the past half century or so being reverse.** And about time, too.

Americans are never going to agree on everything. The political priorities and values of folk in Massachusetts, Minnesota or Mississippi are never going to be precisely aligned. So why not let states do more things differently?

**When the Founders drafted the Constitution, they expected that the Supreme Court would rule on the basis of what the law said, not rule on the basis of what they would like the law to say.** The recent rise of judicial activism has seen this idea of the Court's role abandoned, and in doing so, it has undermined the Constitution, handed power to federal bureaucrats and done a great deal to poison American politics.

A truly conservative Court would recognize this and undo the damage by returning to the more minimalist, restrained role that the Founders envisaged for the Supreme Court. Less Ruth Ginsburg, more James Madison, please.

---
| |
---
Have a great weekend!

Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Will you sponsor a conservative student’s scholarship
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63059%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7eep4KY7y99XM4ObxlN7HQ&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63050%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7PpBFK4bAjEmt38aWdWRXw&sysid=1) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63051%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Y9zIqwVtEA7gllefTb1V5A&sysid=1) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that. The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training? Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship? If so, please use this link to give online right away: Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, Morton C. Blackwell President, Leadership Institute | | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. body:
During these unprecedented times, we have to take action to help those affected the most.
#

Hi friends. It’s Mark Kelly.
The Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_ yesterday. Now, it’s on us to do everything we can to protect the right to an abortion.
I’m sure many of you are pretty scared. Protections that generations of Americans were born with are gone, and this is going to impact people around the country in a lot of different ways. So, right now, we have to take action to support those who need help the most.
That’s why I’m reaching out today to see if you can make a donation to Planned Parenthood Action Fund. 100% of your donation will go to them, and if that’s all you need to hear, you can donate here: [**https://act.markkelly.com/go/PPAF**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-ppaf-june22.ADm_sZ&refcode=em220625-1-7&t=1&akid=3137%2E6688874%2EH-TYdt)
Until we can codify the protections that Roe provided into law, it’s up to health care providers, states, and local governments to provide these critically needed services.
There are a lot of organizations out there fighting hard to protect abortion rights. Planned Parenthood is one of those groups. And they need our help.
By donating here, you can make an immediate difference in supporting the millions of Americans who have lost their right to an abortion.
[**So, will you make a donation to Planned Parenthood Action Fund right now? Your support today will help continue the fight to make sure people can access safe and legal abortion.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-ppaf-june22.ADm_sZ&refcode=em220625-1-7&t=2&akid=3137%2E6688874%2EH-TYdt)

_He can’t believe his approval ratings are in the toilet._

He’s blaming his staff. He’s blaming the media. He’s blaming everyone but himself...

Hello Friend,

Have you ever heard of the World Economic Forum (WEF)?

Lots of people haven't-and WEF is taking advantage of that as they try to install global communism through global corporations and the Great Reset.

Mainstream media fact-checkers say, "there's no such thing as a Great Reset."

Once again, the media fact-checkers are wrong. WEF clearly states its mission on its website:

One of the reasons VoteVets was founded in 2006 was to help elect progressive veterans.
#
Derek -
One of the reasons VoteVets was founded in 2006 was to help elect progressive veterans.
For years, folks in Washington, D.C. saw “veteran” and “Republican” as synonymous, something conservatives used as a cudgel against Democrats. Remember the Swift Boat Veterans for Truth?
But since then VoteVets has worked diligently to help veterans succeed in races from City Council, to Congress and even the presidency.
At the end of every FEC fundraising deadline, we hand out PAC checks to progressive veteran candidates. It helps them report good numbers, it shows veteran support for their campaigns, and it helps ensure they have the resources to win.
We’ve done this for years. Think about people like Ted Lieu, Ruben Gallego, Tammy Duckworth and more.
We want to hand out a few more checks to progressive veteran candidates who need it before this month ends. To send a message VoteVets is with them and to help them WIN.
But we need your help:

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: Together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We’re fighting like the future depends on it, because it does
#
Derek,

If you feel angry, heartbroken, lost, or afraid — you are not alone. ❤️
The Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and dozens of states will now criminalize millions of womens’ bodies.
I am hurting with you. So many of us are.
Derek, **I grew up in a country where abortion was illegal**.
It was illegal, but still one of the top five leading causes of maternal deaths. So please know when I say the loss of _Roe_ is a nightmare, _I really mean it._
When we’re hurting, it can be tempting to do exactly what powerful anti-choice forces want us to do — isolate ourselves and give up. We must do the opposite.
Abortion rights are human rights. We must fight for them, and for each other.
John is running for U.S. Senate to end the archaic filibuster and be the 51st vote we need to codify _Roe_ into law.
He will _always_ put the fights of the people first. He has _always_ believed the right to an abortion is non-negotiable. And sending him to the Senate has never been more important or urgent.
[**_So, Derek, if you can, please rush a donation to John’s campaign today. As the 51st Democratic vote in the U.S. Senate, he will help abolish the filibuster once and for all, so we can codify Roe and make abortion safe + accessible for all._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220625-1?refcode=em20220625-6311&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6311_434096_lAafN3&akid=6311%2E434096%2ElAafN3)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220625-1?refcode=em20220625-6311&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6311_434096_lAafN3&akid=6311%2E434096%2ElAafN3)**
Trust me, I know it can be hard to maintain high hopes. Know that my family + I are sending you love and light. We will fight back, and win, together.
—Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220625-6311-footer&t=1&refcode2=6311_434096_lAafN3&akid=6311%2E434096%2ElAafN3)**

It is more urgent than ever that we win this race for Texas governor.
#
After yesterday's dangerous Supreme Court decision, it is more urgent than ever that we win this race for Texas governor. **There is no other option, and that work begins right now. It can’t wait.**
That's why we're setting an emergency goal of knocking on 30,000 doors and making 150,000 calls this weekend. With over 75,000 volunteers, we're growing one of the largest organizing programs that Texas has ever seen to reach the voters who will decide this election.
It is on each of us to fight for every woman’s freedom to control her own body, health care, and future. We do that by making phone calls to Texans and organizing in every community.
[**Will you sign up today to make calls to Texans this weekend?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52814?utm_source=ema20220625-195447&t=1&akid=195447%2E444211%2Ebqt69t) We need to reach every single voter across Texas to make sure they understand what’s on the line now that _Roe_ has been overturned.

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

We wanted to make sure you had a chance to read Stacey’s note from
yesterday, in the aftermath of the Supreme Court decision overturning Roe
v. Wade.

If you only take away one thing, make it this: a woman’s right to choose
is now up to the states. As governor, Stacey Abrams will defend
reproductive rights and access to health care in Georgia.

We need to elect leaders who will defend women — especially poor, Black,
brown and rural women — LGBTQ+ people and all whose rights are at risk.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B1_RoeBump_S1_T1_HQ_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=747%2E1862389%2EKB_4dw ]Derek, will
you read Stacey’s message, and then chip in to ensure reproductive rights
are protected in Georgia? Anything you can invest in Stacey’s campaign
today will make a real difference.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B1_RoeBump_S1_T1_HQ_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=747%2E1862389%2EKB_4dw ]DONATE

Thank you,

Stacey Abrams HQ

- - - - - Begin original message - - - - -
From: Stacey Abrams
Subject: my response to Roe
Date: Friday, June 24, 2022

Derek,

Today, the United States Supreme Court — the seat of justice charged with
protecting our liberties — struck down reproductive rights. Women today
lost the right to make our own health care decisions and the right to
shape our own future.

As a woman, I am appalled. As a Georgian, I am enraged. As an American, I
am disgusted by this abdication of all we hold dear. We are a better
people than this — and we deserve to have our freedoms protected, not
stripped away.

As of today, the threats to our right to choose are no longer theory.
Brian Kemp, Georgia’s current extremist governor, signed a dangerous bill
to ban abortion after 6 weeks of pregnancy in 2019. It has been held up in
the courts. Now it will soon be the law of the land in Georgia. This means
abortion will be outlawed before most women even know they are pregnant,
and women and doctors can be fined or jailed for seeking or performing
abortions after six weeks. This is outrageous and dangerous — and we will
fight.

Derek, I will
be reaching out soon about what actions we can and must take immediately
in response to today’s decision. But right now I want to be clear: as
Georgia’s next governor, I will fight to defend a woman’s right to choose,
support access to reproductive health care with a comprehensive plan for
Georgia’s women in this new post-Roe era and protect the rights of all.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B1_RoeBump_S1_T1_HQ_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=747%2E1862389%2EKB_4dw ]But first, we have to win in November so I can take office and take
action. Will you make your
first donation to
support our fight for reproductive rights in Georgia?

Derek, as a
legislator, as a woman and as a Georgian, I have spent my career fighting
for reproductive justice. I defeated a bill to inject racial division into
medical decisions. I challenged bills that banned insurance coverage for
abortion. I battled those who sought to limit a woman’s right to control
her body, including the six-week ban that will govern the lives of
Georgians.

As governor, I will work every day to ensure access to affordable and safe
health care for all, including access to abortion. This will not be easy,

We need to elect leaders who will defend women — especially poor, Black, brown and rural women — LGBTQ+ people and all whose rights are at risk. Women today lost the right to make our own health care decisions and the right to shape our own future. As a woman, I am appalled. As a Georgian, I am enraged. As an American, I am disgusted by this abdication of all we hold dear. We are a better people than this — and we deserve to have our freedoms protected, not stripped away. As of today, the threats to our right to choose are no longer theory. Brian Kemp, Georgia’s current extremist governor, signed a dangerous bill to ban abortion after 6 weeks of pregnancy in 2019. It has been held up in the courts. Now it will soon be the law of the land in Georgia. This means abortion will be outlawed before most women even know they are pregnant, and women and doctors can be fined or jailed for seeking or performing abortions after six weeks. This is outrageous and dangerous — and we will fight. Derek, I will be reaching out soon about what actions we can and must take immediately in response to today’s decision. But right now I want to be clear: as Georgia’s next governor, I will fight to defend a woman’s right to choose, support access to reproductive health care with a comprehensive plan for Georgia’s women in this new post-Roe era and protect the rights of all. [ ]But first, we have to win in November so I can take office and take action. Will you make your first donation to support our fight for reproductive rights in Georgia? Derek, as a legislator, as a woman and as a Georgian, I have spent my career fighting for reproductive justice. I defeated a bill to inject racial division into medical decisions. Back in April, they ran an article by a man who had these fine things to say about me: | "Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people." Fellow patriot, Have you heard the unimaginable story of SEAL Commander Job Price?
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp4sbsiuhol8hd3igtcb56etq9bhm1gcf9q1tgk8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chgecor6clh2bs)
---
It's so heartbreaking that even writing about it is difficult for me to do. Job Price was born into a tight knit family in a small town in Pennsylvania. His loving mother and father fostered an environment where Job and his younger sister, Bronwyn, could thrive. According to his teachers, coaches, friends, and family, Job refused to accept anything but his best effort in all that he did. But was also the first to laugh at himself when that ‘best effort’ didn’t quite go as planned. Commander Price understood and embraced the importance of placing the greater good above self at the early age of 18. That’s what led him to serve our country in the military. While serving, SEAL Commander Price quickly rose through the ranks and was described as focused, disciplined, loyal, and dedicated - to name a few. He cared deeply about his country and fought to protect American ideals for his wife, his kid, and all of us. Tragically, while deployed in Afghanistan, Commander Price was found dead on the morning of December 22, 2012, with a pistol in his hand and a pool of blood underneath him. Commander Price showed immense love to all of those he was close to in his life and was always honest with them. That's why when his sudden death got pronounced a suicide by a Navy death review board, his family knew something wasn't right.
---
[**HELP THEM GET THE TRUTH**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7964c9f5db65udqt9jm34o4vl6sk952dfeitvm8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chgecor6clh2bs)
---
One of his former SEAL team members called the board, asking them to consider the possibility of murder and others began pointing out issues in the investigation. **But, to this day, Commander Price's family and friends are still forced to live through the uncertainty that looms around his death. The military refuses to share documents regarding his passing or address the family's concerns about the mishandling of forensic evidence.** UAP is trying to get his family answers. But we need your help to do it.
---

---
The legal process involved in obtaining the necessary documents and information is lengthy and expensive, but this family deserves to know the truth. _**[Donate today to help SEAL Commander Job Price's family get the answers they've waited on for too long. >>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zecsmu33fei3ph63u9s4oodeirj9evi2pi8qjg5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3chgecor6clh2bs)**_ In remembrance, Lieutenant Colonel Weimann

His loving mother and father fostered an environmen | | | Fellow patriot, Have you heard the unimaginable story of SEAL Commander Job Price? It's so heartbreaking that even writing about it is difficult for me to do. Job Price was born into a tight knit family in a small town in Pennsylvania. His loving mother and father fostered an environment where Job and his younger sister, Bronwyn, could thrive. According to his teachers, coaches, friends, and family, Job refused to accept anything but his best effort in all that he did. But was also the first to laugh at himself when that ‘best effort’ didn’t quite go as planned. Commander Price understood and embraced the importance of placing the greater good above self at the early age of 18. That’s what led him to serve our country in the military. While serving, SEAL Commander Price quickly rose through the ranks and was described as focused, disciplined, loyal, and dedicated - to name a few. He cared deeply about his country and fought to protect American ideals for his wife, his kid, and all of us. Tragically, while deployed in Afghanistan, Commander Price was found dead on the morning of December 22, 2012, with a pistol in his hand and a pool of blood underneath him. Commander Price showed immense love to all of those he was close to in his life and was always honest with them. That's why when his sudden death got pronounced a suicide by a Navy death review board, his family knew something wasn't right. One of his former SEAL team members called the board, asking them to consider the possibility of murder and others began pointing out issues in the investigation. But, to this day, Commander Price's family and friends are still forced to live through the uncertainty that looms around his death. The military refuses to share documents regarding his passing or address the family's concerns about the mishandling of forensic evidence. UAP is trying to get his family answers. But we need your help to do it. The legal process involved in obtaining the necessary documents and information is lengthy and expensive, but this family deserves to know the truth. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: What could happen next
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,

When the Dobbs v Jackson Women’s Health Organization draft opinion that would overturn Roe v. Wade leaked in early May, I said “it’s all the same fight.” Now more than ever, this bears repeating.

The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice.

The direct result of the Supreme Court’s final ruling announced yesterday is that millions of women in Michigan lose nearly every right to make choices about their own bodies and futures -- and could be subject to a heavily restrictive anti-choice law that dates back nearly a century.

This is not an isolated decision or a single moment. This the cumulative effect of a 40-year assault on our rights by extremists on the far right, from the Federalist Society and law schools, to circuit courts and the three most recent appointees to the Supreme Court. Candidates around the country for every office are using their platforms to attack womens’ rights, regardless of the office’s responsibility.

These extremists and their hand-picked judges will go even further. They will strip as many federal protections as possible from those who need them most. They will "return" these decisions to the states, where in many cases the deck is already stacked due to partisan gerrymandering, judicial appointments, and voter suppression.

The Dobbs decision essentially eliminates the constitutional right to privacy, which opens the door to the elimination of many other protections and freedoms - from contraception to marriage equality. And yesterday’s opinion sets the stage to eliminate voting as a fundamental constitutional right, and all the protections that come with it.

This is not some far off apocalyptic vision of the future – it’s what could happen in the next five years.

So what can we do about it? State and local elections matter more than ever. And having fair, accurate elections takes on even more importance. The majority of Americans support a woman’s right to choose. It’s up to all of us to make sure election results reflect that majority.

The preservation of every constitutional right we have left depends on whether we exercise the right to vote – and make sure every vote is counted.

Like I said: The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice.

It’s all the same fight.

I’m grateful that you’re with me in it.

-Jocelyn

The direct result of the Supreme Court’s final ruling announced yesterday is that millions of women in Michigan lose nearly every right to make choices about their own bodies and futures -- and could be subject to a heavily restrictive anti-choice law that dates back nearly a century. This is not an isolated decision or a single moment. This the cumulative effect of a 40-year assault on our rights by extremists on the far right, from the Federalist Society and law schools, to circuit courts and the three most recent appointees to the Supreme Court. Candidates around the country for every office are using their platforms to attack womens’ rights, regardless of the office’s responsibility. These extremists and their hand-picked judges will go even further. They will strip as many federal protections as possible from those who need them most. They will "return" these decisions to the states, where in many cases the deck is already stacked due to partisan gerrymandering, judicial appointments, and voter suppression. The Dobbs decision essentially eliminates the constitutional right to privacy, which opens the door to the elimination of many other protections and freedoms - from contraception to marriage equality. And yesterday’s opinion sets the stage to eliminate voting as a fundamental constitutional right, and all the protections that come with it. This is not some far off apocalyptic vision of the future – it’s what could happen in the next five years. So what can we do about it? State and local elections matter more than ever. And having fair, accurate elections takes on even more importance. The majority of Americans support a woman’s right to choose. It’s up to all of us to make sure election results reflect that majority. The preservation of every constitutional right we have left depends on whether we exercise the right to vote – and make sure every vote is counted. Like I said: The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice. It’s all the same fight. I’m grateful that you’re with me in it. -Jocelyn secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=062422 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=062422] [] This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | | | **June 25, 2022** |
---|---|---|---
| | |
### Defending Reproductive Freedom
Yesterday's [outrageous ruling](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15624.35719669.5809826.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-supreme-court-ruling-overturning-roe-v-wade&redir_log=810049422029848) from the far-right packed Supreme Court jeopardizes the health of millions of women around our nation and their ability to participate as full and equal members of our society. The Supreme Court has thrown aside the Constitution and is instead [forcing its ideological beliefs down the throats of the American people](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15624.35719669.5809826.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1540355781199278080&redir_log=154379901007374). This is a [results-driven ruling](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15624.35719669.5809826.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1540346477364510720&redir_log=078409987903373), not a rule of law decision, and it undermines the Court's legitimacy. It not only overturns the law of our land that has been in place for almost fifty years - it also flies directly in the face of the will of our country. The American people don't want elected officials interfering in their most personal, private decisions.

And this is just step one of the anti-choice, far-right's plan. Next, they are going to try to secure a majority in Congress that will pass a national law banning the right to choose - and make abortions illegal. Such a national law would override Maryland state law codifying the protections guaranteed under _Roe v. Wade_ - which dates back to 1991. A concurring opinion written by Justice Clarence Thomas affirming the opinion of the Court further suggests that yesterday's ruling should prompt a reexamination of other constitutional rights that have been on the books for years. That includes the right to access contraception and the right to marry whom you love.

Let's be clear: this action is the premeditated outcome of years of plotting by the right-wing legal movement and the Republican Party. But we cannot waver in our commitment to protecting reproductive rights. The Congress must act now to protect women's rights to make decisions about their own bodies, and I'll be fighting with everything I've got to do that. We must mobilize the country and win the votes to pass the Women's Health Protection Act.
---
### Keeping Our Communities Safe
In the wake of the devastating shootings in Buffalo, Uvalde, and right here in Maryland, the American people have been calling for action on gun safety. This week, we took a modest but meaningful step forward to do just that with the passage of the [Bipartisan Safer Communities Act](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15624.35719669.5809826.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-the-bipartisan-safer-communities-act&redir_log=815685874911798). This legislation will make our communities safer by funding state red flag laws to keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals; closing the "boyfriend loophole" so domestic abusers are barred from having a gun; making gun trafficking a federal crime; and toughening penalties for those who make illegal "straw" purchases. It also includes additional resources for mental health services in schools and communities. I was glad to vote for this bill this week and see it signed into law this morning.

But make no mistake: we have a lot more work to do on gun safety legislation in Congress. I'm very proud that the Maryland state legislature has taken action over several decades to pass meaningful firearm regulations to reduce gun violence in our state. We've closed the gun show loophole; we have universal background checks and a red flag law; we don't allow the sale of semi-automatic assault weapons; and we require a permit to purchase a handgun. These are just a few of the important regulations that have helped keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals.

But Maryland is not an island. Over half of the traced guns recovered in crimes committed in Maryland were purchased in other states. Without robust national gun safety laws, all of us in Maryland are more vulnerable. If we want to end these mass shootings and confront the daily toll of gun violence, it can't just be a one state approach. We need national legislation modeled after the meaningful reform we've enacted in Maryland. So while the enactment of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act was a small step forward, we must continue the fight to pass comprehensive national gun safety laws.

The urgency to act on this issue continues. This week's Supreme Court ruling from the six Republican-appointed justices on the Court [overturning a New York State gun law](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15624.35719669.5809826.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-supreme-court-ruling-on-concealed-carry&redir_log=059521646512819) is not only a misreading of the Constitution, it's going to make Americans less safe. Maryland is one of seven states in the nation that has a law on the books that's similar to the one struck down in New York, and the Supreme Court's decision means many more individuals can carry concealed weapons. I look forward to consulting with Maryland Attorney General Frosh to review our options to prevent a surge of people carrying hidden weapons in our state.

We have a long fight ahead to protect reproductive freedom, enact robust gun safety legislation nationwide, and tackle so many other challenges facing our communities. But I know that the overwhelming majority of Marylanders and Americans support reproductive freedom and common-sense gun safety provisions. I am confident that if we stand shoulder-to-shoulder, we will prevail. That spirit has guided the progress we've already made, and that spirit will continue to guide our progress into the future. Chris Van Hollen

[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Yesterday, the Supreme Court officially released their ruling for Dobbs
v. Jackson Women's Health Organization and erased federal protections for
abortion access.

We know that this moment can feel scary and hopeless. But we want to make
this clear: Our fight isn’t over,
Peter.

So now we have a choice:

* We either let far-right politicians like Rand Paul continue stacking
anti-abortion judges on our courts and passing legislation that
restricts our reproductive rights.
* Or we channel our grassroots power this upcoming election to elect
leaders who will proudly vote to protect abortion access.

This moment is an urgent reminder why we’re running to replace Rand Paul
and fighting to expand our Democratic majority in the Senate. Our chances
of passing policies that would protect our right to an abortion hinges on
this election.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220625.Y-DzLf&refcode=em20220625-2124&t=1001&akid=2124%2E346206%2EAEFxwr ]Can you rush a $5 contribution to support our campaign
and movement’s work in defense of abortion rights? Every dollar sends a
powerful message to far-right politicians that we are more powerful than
their anti-abortion agenda.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220625.Y-DzLf&refcode=em20220625-2124&t=1020&akid=2124%2E346206%2EAEFxwr ]Contribute $5

It’s no secret that Rand Paul has been working for years
to make this moment happen.

Just take a look at this email he sent in support of the “Life at
Conception Act” — a total and unequivocal nationwide ban on abortion,
without exception for rape or incest.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220625.Y-DzLf&refcode=em20220625-2124&t=1021&akid=2124%2E346206%2EAEFxwr ][IMG]

What’s happening right now — from Rand’s support for a nationwide abortion
ban, to the Supreme Court deciding to repeal Roe v. Wade — is an urgent
warning of what’s to come if we don’t take action now.

We must abolish the filibuster. We must pass the Women’s Health Protection
Act. We must keep organizing to make sure everyone has quality healthcare,
including abortion coverage. We must expand the Supreme Court.

But to make this a reality, we must replace anti-abortion Senators like
Rand Paul and expand our majority so we can pass the policies we need.

We need your help to make this happen,
Peter. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220625.Y-DzLf&refcode=em20220625-2124&t=1022&akid=2124%2E346206%2EAEFxwr ]Will you chip
in $5 right now to show Rand Paul that this movement is
rising up to end his political career?

Together,

Team Booker

It was made worse by the comments of our Governor, who laid out his plan to ban abortion after 15 weeks in Virginia. Yesterday our rights were taken away by six cravenly partisan judges. One governor will attempt to strip them away at the state level as soon as he can. Elections have consequences — and we’re seeing those consequences right now. Pro-Choice Democrats aren’t giving up. Virginia Democrats aren’t giving up. We need you to stay in the fight too.This isn’t over in Virginia — the fight is just beginning. That’s why we’re asking you again. We need your support today, tomorrow, this year, next year, and for as long as Governor Youngkin is in office. = Glenn Youngkin promised to “go on offense” on abortion during the 2021 campaign and he’s going to do whatever he can to make good on that promise. = This is going to be a long fight, but the Democratic Party of Virginia is always here working to defend you and protect your rights. We hope you’ll join us. Virginia Democrats | =****** =******** [content goes here] Democratic Party of Virginia PO Box 448 Richmond, VA 23218 United States Paid for by the Democratic Party of Virginia, www.vademocrats.org. But team, here in New Jersey, WE have the power to do something about it. My opponent, Tom Kean Jr., has consistently chosen to side with the most extreme pro-Trump wing of the GOP in his fourth, desperate effort to get into Congress. name: Adam Schiff
subject: We must expand the Supreme Court.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Today’s Supreme Court is unfair, unjust, and no longer reflects what our founding fathers intended it to be — it’s being used purely as a tool for the GOP to unilaterally reverse progress and strike down our fundamental rights, starting with Roe v. Wade.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=418%2E5257348%2EWT4psW)
Derek, we must expand the Supreme Court.
It is, by far, the most unrepresentative U.S. institution in our government, yet it is also one of the most powerful.
**We saw the consequences of its imbalance just yesterday. After the installation of _three_ Trump-appointed justices, the hyper-partisan Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , ending the constitutional right to an abortion.**
It’s shocking and heartbreaking — but given the makeup of the current Court, it’s also, unfortunately, not surprising. In fact, this has been the Republican plan for decades.
And with members of the Court enjoying lifelong appointments, we’re stuck with their staunchly partisan, extreme agenda for **generations, unless we act.**
It shouldn’t be this way. **Today’s Supreme Court is unfair, unjust, and no longer reflects what our founding fathers intended it to be — it’s being used as a purely partisan tool for Republicans to unilaterally reverse progress and strike down our fundamental rights, starting with _Roe v. Wade._**
Congress must take action. Adding additional justices to the Supreme Court is nothing new historically, and doing this will help restore legitimacy and ensure our nation’s highest court doesn’t continue to be used to advance a partisan agenda at odds with the interests of the American people. In short, McConnell and Trump stacked the court, and we must unstack it.
[**Derek, join me in demanding Congress expand the Supreme Court by adding your name now.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20220625-expand-scotus.YGTiAY&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220625_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=418%2E5257348%2EWT4psW)

Thank you for taking the time to read this, and for taking action.

body:
Now it’s time to restore a culture of life in America. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-8902731?e=17913c7d6d)

| | |

| | |
#
Friends,

**Yesterday was nothing short of historic**.

By overturning Roe v. Wade, the Supreme Court ended the horrid and unconstitutional federally-protected “right” to destroy the life of the unborn. States now have the power to set their own abortion laws.

And by all accounts, life is winning in America.

As _Fox News_ [explained](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=88c81beb81&e=17913c7d6d), “thirteen states in the country are poised to enact immediate abortion bans and at least 13 more could quickly follow suit after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade on Friday.”

My first [thought](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1a2c325c09&e=17913c7d6d) when I heard the news was:
---
|
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=70b2dd829b&e=17913c7d6d)
---
**Countless men and women dedicated their lives to ending Roe**.

They’re unsung heroes and their hard work and persistence paid off. Now, with Roe behind us, we must fight the battle within the states and work to restore a culture of life in America.

My wife, Mary Vought, and I wrote this [piece](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f7c8ee84b8&e=17913c7d6d) in 2014 about our daughter born with Cystic Fibrosis. We were given “options” but choosing life was always the only option, a decision that has revealed God’s eternal blessings time and again.
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

body:
| | | Dear Friend, The Supreme Court ruling overturning Roe v. Wade stripped away fundamental reproductive rights from millions of people. Women in states with abortion bans across the country will attempt unsafe procedures in order to control their own body. It’s an obscene, cruel decision. To makes matter worse, Clarence Thomas called for the overturning of the cases that decided same-sex marriage, same-sex relationships, and contraception. This is just the precipice of what is to come. We can’t stop fighting. We won’t stop fighting. A few hours after the ruling, I spoke to tens of thousands of people gathered outside the steps of the Supreme Court. I didn’t mince words. I didn’t hold back. I said what so many of us are feeling right now: How did it come to this? We know the Republicans are ruthless. They’ve used every scheme possible to secure a conservative ultra-majority on the Supreme Court despite losing the popular vote in every election but one for the past _34 years._ But what is the response from Democratic leadership? An exploratory committee? Democratic leadership had 50 years to codify Roe v. Wade. They knew that this was coming. And where was Majority Leader Hoyer last month? He was campaigning for a pro-life candidate who was facing a pro-choice challenger. **Is that the best we can do???** The fact of the matter is that we need better leaders. We need leaders who get it. When I was a teenager, I became pregnant. I was terrified, making minimum wage, and was not ready to have a child. With financial help from my aunt, I was able to have an abortion. I’m now raising two wonderful kids, who I had when I was ready. I remember what that fear was like at the time. Abortion clinics in red states are already calling hundreds of people, letting them know that their appointment has been cancelled because of the decision. They’re feeling that fear now. [I’m asking you to find, support, and donate to your local abortion fund. ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXVxE7f7x06dBGXbJjes8AXLUOoAO6H5_sYF3iIqYLMHjAqeb9RllPVqlCdQI9TxHoW9aK6lRLHn94yRui1F_kNlGpoLFY30BxTHQDPkjud8lw4NBhr6_V3-N7Wq2JjJpMbo7CF_CYo9ze4psLTitUrJ0AIfY4bvoovvQR6FF7C6EwHbqVr4YRej3n7KIQnE5QznmqcOhnsnRd6_EbcIaSBZxLvQdExUY2FLURcfVDIC8F3BIeenSnMssff-5p4Ry19yefpQwJ0jvIW-wBbntIPQ8bJD54r7Xr4qAp4OOBOYN/3n7/mauN7EktRnGooSitCv_wng/h0/5qBNpGyhNBrKapJBLjkEoMjDLvtxVXuJDM0wL7zXqrI)Whether it’s a group in a blue state that will be seeing an influx of new people in need, or a group in a red state who will be facing legal fights – they need your help today. We can’t stop fighting. We won’t stop fighting. Because this is just the beginning. In solidarity, Mckayla Wilkes

name: Maggie Hassan
subject: Yesterday's ruling is just the beginning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
If Mitch McConnell is in charge, abortion will be banned in all 50 states. | | |
---
Listen – In the wake of _Roe v. Wade_ being overturned, one thing has been made abundantly clear. **We cannot afford to lose this seat.** If I lose, Republicans will take control of the Senate, paving the way for a national abortion ban. Let me say that again: Yesterday's ruling is just the beginning. If Mitch McConnell is in charge, abortion will be banned in all 50 states. **This is what's at stake this November.** But I'm facing a tough reelection fight. Every single one of my opponents running against me — and yes, they are all men — is pushing an extreme, anti-choice agenda. One of my opponents **spearheaded New Hampshire's first abortion ban** in modern history and explicitly said he opposes ANY exceptions for rape or incest. Another has been an anti-choice activist for decades, **promising to "end abortion once and for all."** If elected to the Senate, they would rubber-stamp Mitch McConnell's extreme agenda. They would push to jail women for seeking abortions and doctors for providing them. They would defund family planning clinics. And they would vote to confirm Supreme Court Justices who will continue to strip Americans of their fundamental rights. The stakes have never been higher: if we’re going to safeguard the right to an abortion, we need to protect and expand our Senate majority. So I'm urgently asking for your support because the future of reproductive rights will be decided here in New Hampshire. **[Please chip in $5 or any amount you can to keep this seat and our Senate majority in Democratic hands.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46979460/352554132/-1829049351?refcode=mh-0625-roe&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmE4ZTU5Ni1jNWY0LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sTb4zqVcu9fgnWJo_S0bBII0kI5OTew5EWNLHFhPPRI=)** | | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46979461/352554133/-1829049351?refcode=mh-0625-roe&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmE4ZTU5Ni1jNWY0LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sTb4zqVcu9fgnWJo_S0bBII0kI5OTew5EWNLHFhPPRI=)

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Progress is possible. A better world is possible.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This morning, President Biden signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act
#

Friends -
We made history.
For decades, survivors and gun safety advocates have been working towards this moment. This morning, President Biden signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law.
This is the first major gun safety legislation in almost 30 years, and we stood up to the NRA, the National Shooting Sports Foundation, and the entire gun lobby to make it reality.
Expanded extreme risk (aka red flag) laws, intensive background checks for anyone under 21 trying to buy a gun, closing the boyfriend loophole... these are policies that will save lives. And none of them would be law if advocates like you had not had the courage to pressure Congress to act.
I’m often asked how I can stay optimistic during this long, hard, haul. On the heels of two devastating Supreme Court rulings, the signing of new gun safety legislation shows us we can move ahead—despite the obstacles and setbacks.
On January 30, 2013, a little over a month after Sandy Hook, I addressed Congress for the first time since being shot. I told my former colleagues to “be bold, be courageous, Americans are counting on you.”
And since then, as we’ve worked together to fight gun violence, I’ve been reminded almost daily that when people care for each other and work together, progress is possible. A better world is possible. But we can’t give up fighting for it.
So today, we look back with a somber acknowledgement of the lives taken by gun violence, and we look ahead with the conviction that the future will be a little bit brighter.
The fight to protect our communities from gun violence is far from over—there is still so much work to be done. Even as we celebrate this success, the entire team at Giffords is going to continue to fight for additional reforms needed to save lives.
But just like passing this legislation took a grassroots movement of survivors and advocates demanding action, further progress will only come if we continue to fight for it—together.
[**If you can, please consider making a contribution to Giffords PAC today. With your support, we can build on the first significant gun safety legislation in 30 years and make our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june22.JkdLIw&refcode=em220625-1-subs&t=1&akid=2177%2E3935704%2EEvkXNw)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june22.JkdLIw&refcode=em220625-1-subs&t=2&akid=2177%2E3935704%2EEvkXNw)**
With courage,
Gabby

| | En qué me distingo: Yo construyo en lugar de derribar. He compartido el escenario con seis candidatos republicanos. Lo he hecho cuatro veces en el último mes y la retórica se vuelve más extrema con cada evento. Esta última semana estuve en Tonasket y uno de los candidatos declaró que se sentiría desnudo sin su arma y estábamos en el auditorio de una escuela. Su agenda es singular: Destituir a Biden y eliminar su administración ilegítima, desmantelar el Departamento de Educación para que todos los niños puedan ser educados en casa, eliminar todas las restricciones a la adquisición de armas y eliminar el gobierno de la salud, para privatizarla por completo en busca de eficiencia y ganancias financieras. Trato de entender su agenda y todo lo que escucho es anarquía sin ningún plan de futuro. ¿Cuál es el beneficio de tener un país de ciudadanos armados, sin gobierno, mal educados y enfermos? Mi plan para el futuro de la parte central de Washington es muy diferente. Ofreceré independencia financiera y energética. Nos libraremos de la dependencia de los combustibles fósiles para el año 2030 y devolveré el dinero de nuestros impuestos para invertirlo en nosotros. Invirtiendo el dinero de nuestros impuestos en nosotros mismos podremos reconstruir nuestra infraestructura, liberarnos de los combustibles fósiles para el 2030 y atraer a la industria con empleos de salario familiar.\- Doug
---
| How I am different. I build up rather than tear down. I have been sharing the stage with six republican candidates. I have done this four times over the last month and the rhetoric gets more extreme with each event. This last week I was in Tonasket and one of the candidates declared that he would feel naked without his gun and we were in a school auditorium. Their agenda is singular: Impeach Biden and remove his illegitimate administration, dismantle the Department of Education so all kids can be homeschooled, remove all restrictions on gun ownership and remove government from healthcare, completely privatizing it for efficiency and profit. I try to figure out their agenda and all I hear is anarchy without any future plans. What is the benefit of having a country of gun-toting, governmentless, poorly educated, and sickly citizens. My plan for the future of Central Washington is vastly different. I will deliver financial and energy independence. We will be free from dependence on fossil fuels by 2030 and I will bring our tax dollars back to invest in us! By investing our tax dollars in ourselves we can rebuild our infrastructure, be free of fossil fuels by 2030 and attract industry with family-wage jobs.\- Doug

body:
Congress needs to step up NOW and codify Roe. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/819b9edb3814/i-am-running-for-congress-9133146?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dbf5eda83a&e=356c0699dd)
---
| For the first time in U.S. history, the Supreme Court took the unprecedented step of removing a fundamental right that had previously been granted to the citizens of this country. Because of this decision, millions of people will now have a private medical decision criminalized.

**This decision does not “just” restore power to the states for the people of those states to decide whether they want abortion to be criminalized. It sends private medical decisions to states where the majority doesn’t elect their government anymore thanks to gerrymandering**. It creates a legally unworkable web of laws that may very well result in our privacy rights being invaded by the state to ensure that an abortion has not taken place. It changes how people have to live their lives.

The government does not belong in the private medical decisions of citizens of this country. The decision to have an abortion is a healthcare decision that is to be made by the person making the decision.

**Congress needs to step up NOW and codify Roe.** [Sign our petition to let Rep. Scott Fitzgerald and Congress know](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=fd5aa92cb7&e=356c0699dd) that their constituents overwhelmingly support everyone’s fundamental right to privacy and access to abortion care in their home state, and that [they must ACT NOW.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=96711289be&e=356c0699dd)

Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg
