Our Wisconsin Revolution Executive Director Andre Walton joined Bernie
Sanders last week at the CNH strike in Mt. Pleasant, WI — nearly 1,000

healthcare benefits and fighting for good wages.

Bernie was on a Worker Power Tour, stopping in Illinois, Iowa, Wisconsin,
and other states for rallies and strikes with thousands of workers and
unionists across the midwest!

uber-Capitalist culture of today,” Bernie said to a roaring crowd. “While
workers died by the thousands from Covid, billionaires grew their wealth
by $2T. We are in a truly pivotal moment in American history.”

[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1034&akid=3086%2E5885482%2EwUq1ai ]Corporate greed is at the root of the war against workers from

like hell to maximize the resurgence of worker power to restore democracy.
Join us in the fight.

We can’t let Biden backpedal on his commitment to clean energy. America

Become a RECURRING DONOR right now to help shift economic and political power to the working class! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Join us LIVE this Monday at 8:30p ET/5:30 PT, when Our Revolution will host a special call to Build Worker Power with SEIU, CWA, Fight for $15 and a Union. We’ll be organizing directly with US Rep. Ro Khanna, labor leaders, and fast-food workers around transformative labor legislation (AB-257) in CA, the fight of federal contract workers, and how we can keep growing the labor movement in America! [ ]RSVP And, mark your calendar for Monday, July 11, when Pramila Jayapal will join our live call! ★ ★ ★ ROE v. WADE GONE IT'S TIME TO FIGHT! [ ][IMG] Our Revolution has been taking to the streets in anticipation of the horrific decision to overturn abortion rights that the authoritarian Supreme Court issued Friday, undermining privacy protections for all Americans and turning back women’s rights half a century. And, sadly, Democrats do not have an effective response to this threat, even though they control the Senate, the House, and the White House. Republicans and the far-right worked hard for this for 50 years - fighting to infiltrate every level of power to force the change they wanted. We must organize and fight for progress with even greater tenacity – we refuse to just watch in horror as women’s healthcare, human rights, and basic autonomy are decimated. [ ]Our membership is ready to stand up and take action against these threats at the ballot box and in the streets. Sign up as a member right now to help our movement stem the tide of fascism. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Congratulations to Our Revolution-endorsed Zachary Parker, who won his race Tuesday for the Ward 5 seat on DC Council! Zach is laser-focused on improving life for the people who call the District of Columbia home - and he believes in community power to do it! “Economic violence is running rampant in this country. We must fundamentally disrupt the systems that perpetuate poverty,” he told us on our [ ]National Organizing Call. “The only way to beat organized money is with organized people.” [ ]Zachary won on a small-donor, publicly-funded campaign with the help of our volunteers and organizers. Become a recurring donor to Our Revolution today to get progressives in power at all levels of government. ★ ★ ★ TIME TO VOTE IN ILLINOIS! [ ][IMG] Tuesday is Election Day in Illinois, and Our Revolution has a powerful slate of progressive champions on the ballot! [ ]Find your polling place HERE! We have multiple chances to add progressives to Congress with Junaid Ahmed (IL-8), Litesa Wallace (IL-17), and Delia Ramirez (IL-3). All three are committed to the fight for Medicare for All, a living wage, a green economy, and more! Bernie joins our endorsement of Delia as well as Jonathan Jackson, who’s running for Congress in IL-1. “The issues Our Revolution Illinois espouses - workers’ rights, clean energy, criminal justice, to name a few, align with the types of policies I believe will deliver the best long-term benefits to my district.” [ ][IMG] And, Our Revolution endorses Alexi Giannoulias, who’s running for Secretary of State as a staunch defender of democracy who vows to put people first and stand up to powerful interests. Early voting is open through Election Day on Tuesday! [ ]Sign up to make calls to voters in Illinois to get folks to the polls for our Illinois Slate! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] VOTE TUESDAY FOR NY GOVERNOR & LT GOV! Our Revolution has been pounding the pavement to help elect Jumaane Williams for NY Governor and Ana Maria Archila for Lt. Governor — on the ballot this Tuesday against the establishment! Jumaane and Ana Maria aren’t just great candidates, they’re excellent organizers with deep ties to local communities and activists — real leaders within our movement. They’re already fighting for the NY Health Act, taxing the wealthy, making CUNY tuition-free, housing justice, and more. Let’s kick out Cuomo’s lackey replacements and elect our allies to lead New York! [ ][IMG] Our Revolution also recently joined Ana Maria, US Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (who endorsed her!), and Brittany Ramos DeBarros for Congress (NY-11) for the NYC Puerto Rican Day Parade! [ ]Sign up to join the Our Revolution family and keep growing our coalition inside and outside of government! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] This 2022 primary season, Our Revolution Phonebank Force has made 500,000 phone calls to voters across the country! We’re recruiting as many folks as possible to help us hit that one-million mark and beyond! Right now, we have shifts for incredible candidates for Congress like Brittany Ramos-DeBarros (NY-11), Andy Levin (MI-11), David Segal (RI-2), and many others! “Our crew is there to help every step of the way, and it’s amazing to see our collective impact on these races,” said Amanda Walker, one of our lead phone bankers. “This is how we turn the tide against big money – and it’s fun!” [ ]MAKE AN IMPACT WITH THE PHONEBANK FORCE! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Already in 2022, we’ve clinched important progressive wins for Congress with Greg Casar (TX-35), Summer Lee (PA-12), Jasmine Crockett (TX-30), Jamie McLeod Skinner (OR-5), Michelle Vallejo (TX-15), and others! Even as corporate Dems sabotage their own prospects for the midterms, we are growing our power at every level of government. Let’s build on this momentum and change the composition of power in politics. [ ]Pitch in here to help us take down the worst corporate puppets before they forfeit what’s left of our democracy to the far right in November! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] JOINING BERNIE ON HIS WORKER POWER TOUR Our Wisconsin Revolution Executive Director Andre Walton joined Bernie Sanders last week at the CNH strike in Mt. Pleasant, WI — nearly 1,000 workers are on strike in WI and IA, fighting to preserve affordable healthcare benefits and fighting for good wages. Bernie was on a Worker Power Tour, stopping in Illinois, Iowa, Wisconsin, and other states for rallies and strikes with thousands of workers and unionists across the midwest! In a [ ]speech Bernie delivered at the Chicago Labor Notes Conference, Bernie sent a message to billionaires like Jeff Bezos and Howard Schultz: “One way or another your companies are going to be organized.” “The time is long overdue for us to take on and challenge the uber-Capitalist culture of today,” Bernie said to a roaring crowd. “While workers died by the thousands from Covid, billionaires grew their wealth by $2T. We are in a truly pivotal moment in American history.” [ ]Corporate greed is at the root of the war against workers from inflation to low wages, offshoring jobs to high gas prices — you name it. That’s why Our Revolution and our founder Bernie Sanders continue to fight like hell to maximize the resurgence of worker power to restore democracy. Join us in the fight. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] BERNIE SKEWERS GRAHAM IN FOX NEWS DEBATE! Bernie Sanders took on fellow Senator Lindsey Graham in a debate on Fox News last week – and wiped the floor with him for all to see! Bernie introduced himself to the rightwing audience as the longest-serving Independent in Congress and gave an unfettered breakdown of Medicare for All, a living wage, taxing the ultra-rich, and more. Graham still blamed Bernie for every failure of corporate Democrats (and Republicans) from the past 40 years, and laughably claimed the problems we see today are the result of Biden implementing Bernie's agenda — WE WISH! “Lindsey avoids the facts and diverts from the most important issues facing this country, that’s what the establishment does,” Bernie rebutted. “And, Lindsey is a good and effective representative of the establishment.” Bernie wisely used his time to drive home critical facts and ideas that Fox News omits and demonizes — like that billionaires are criminally raking in record profits for inflating prices and that Medicare for All could cut healthcare spending in half, [ ]The Guardian reports. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] RO KHANNA OFFERS BIDEN BOLD INFLATION FIXES We’re all feeling the pain of inflation, and like US Rep. Ro Khanna wrote in the [ ]New York Times: “There is way more Biden can do to lower prices.” Our Revolution stands with Ro and Bernie in urging the Biden administration to enact solutions to the current 40-year inflation high that don’t further crush the working class — not just leave it to the Fed to raise interest rates, jack up unemployment, and force down wages ahead of the midterms. Ro argues that Biden must not be afraid to take on corporate greed, take bold action to shore up supply, or implement a Windfall Profits Tax. Fossil fuel giants raked in $93B last quarter alone, and food is up 30 per cent while companies like Tyson saw a 140% jump in profits. Enough is enough! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] BUST BIG TECH MAJOR BILLS TO TAKE ON TECH’S MONOPOLY POWER! A small number of companies have way too much power, and it’s crippling our democracy. Join Our Revolution in a strategic [ ]national campaign to bust the power of the big tech monopolies acting as gatekeepers to the public square. The Open Apps Markets Act and the American Innovation and Choice Act have a REAL SHOT TO PASS and would enable fair competition on Big Tech platforms and app markets. This will create fairness for small businesses and empower users with more choice on the platforms. HBO’s John Oliver featured our legislation on his show Last Week Tonight, exposing how Amazon and Google stifle competition and saying: “These bills would crack the door open,” [ ]The Verge reports. [ ]You can take a quick and simple action to kick off this fight! CALL YOUR SENATORS NOW and tell them you want these two important bills passed! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] BIG OIL’S PRICE GOUGING MUST BE STOPPED Our Revolution continues to ramp up our campaign to end massive taxpayer handouts to the fossil fuel industry — especially now as they gouge us at the pump and rake in exorbitant profits! President Biden recently enacted the Defense Production Act to spur domestic clean energy production and this week, the House passed Cori Bush’s bill for $100M to fund it! — BUT the very same day, Biden rewarded fossil fuel companies with a $10B tax break by suspending the gas tax. The White House met with fossil fuel executives this week, who called President Biden “a bully” and likely greenlit the administration’s weak gas tax holiday to save folks $0.18/gallon. While the White House meets with fossil fuel execs and Biden begs for oil in Saudi Arabia (responsible for killing an American journalist and the genocide against Yemen), Big Oil is buying back its own stocks rather than investing in American energy. Our Revolution joins Bernie in calling for a Windfall Profits Tax, and we call on the Senate to pass Bernie’s bill to fund the Defense Production Act. We can’t let Biden backpedal on his commitment to clean energy. America must transition to renewable energy for our environmental and economic prosperity — and so we’re not at the mercy of Petro-oligarchs in Russia and beyond. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] RALLYING FOR CLIMATE ACTION IN NJ Our Revolution New Jersey turned out in force for our planet Thursday, joining the Rally for Clean Air and Climate Justice, organized by Empower NJ! We called on Gov. Phil Murphy to enact a moratorium on fossil fuel projects and support a just transition to renewable energy that creates jobs and improves life for the people of NJ and the world. With seven new fossil projects moving forward in the state, our chapters were proud to take part as a member of the No Fossil Fuel Projects coalition. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] STANDING w/BERNIE TO EXPAND SOCIAL SECURITY Our grandparents shouldn’t be struggling to survive on $18k a year. Our Revolution wholeheartedly endorses Senator Sanders’ SS Expansion Act! Last week, as Chair of the Senate Budget Committee, Bernie held a hearing on his proposal, which would not only save Social Security but would expand benefits now and fund the program for 75 years! How? By implementing fair taxation on the ultrawealthy. We’re proud to stand with our ally Social Security Works in this fight, and loved seeing their Executive Director Alex Lawson set Lindsey Graham straight with facts during Bernie’s hearing! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] OUR REV ON MSNBC A CALL FOR ACTION TO DEFEND DEMOCRACY Last week, Our Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese made the case for the MSNBC audience to join us in calling on state elections officials to enforce the Constitution and bar insurrectionists from the ballot. The January 6th hearings are reminding us that Trump and his co-conspirators are a danger to the Republic, but “while Congress has the power to investigate - it has no power to prosecute,” Joseph told Zerlina Maxwell on her network show. “Our Constitution is clear,” he said. “Just like if you don’t meet the age requirement to run for office, if you engage in an attempted violent overthrow of the U.S. government, you’re ineligible for office.” Let’s just say - folks like Matt Gaetz, Scott Perry, and Andy Biggs wouldn’t be [ ]asking for pardons if they were on the right side of the Constitution. We need progressive patriots to lend their voice against the rise of fascism by [ ]signing this petition to urge your state elections officials to do their job and disqualify criminals from seeking re-election. Our Revolution has rallied in states like PA, OH, and AZ – [ ]calling out extremists like Lauren Boebert, Paul Gosar, and others. And, our members’ legal challenges have gained traction, even forcing Marjorie Taylor Greene under oath in Georgia! If you want to volunteer for this campaign and hold January 6th criminals accountable, please [ mailto:defenddemocracy@ourrevolution.com ]email us! [ ]SIGN THE PETITION ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] VICTORY! Our Revolution Ohio ran nearly 400 progressives for Central Committee positions across the state’s 58 counties, outmaneuvered the Party Machine, and WON! In Greene County, an Our Revolution member was elected as Party Chair; and in Cuyahoga County, a partner for party reform and our coalition, David Brock, won Party Chair and State Rep. and Nina surrogate Juanita Brent was elected Vice-Chair. It all started at Our Revolution Ohio’s 2020 Organize-to-Win Summit with a plan to Transform the Party – and now we have seats of power to work for true democratic reformation. With deep organizing, our members built coalitions, phone banked, held workshops and training sessions, walked door-to-door, and put in the work to change the composition of the Party in Ohio. This is a huge win, and we’re pulling over folks who didn’t think they were progressive. “The party has been on life support, and during a time when our call is to Defend Democracy, people are seeing that if we don’t do something now, there will be no democracy to defend,” said our Revolution Ohio Organizer Diane Morgan. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Join us LIVE this Monday at 8:30p ET/5:30 PT, when Our Revolution will host a special call to Build Worker Power with SEIU, CWA, Fight for $15 and a Union. We’ll be organizing directly with US Rep. Ro Khanna, labor leaders, and fast-food workers around transformative labor legislation (AB-257) in CA, the fight of federal contract workers, and how we can keep growing the labor movement in America! [ ]RSVP ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] DEFEND DEMOCRACY PETITION The January 6th hearings are underway, but Congress only has the power to investigate - not prosecute. That’s why Our Revolution is calling on secretaries of state to do their job, enforce the Constitution, and bar insurrectionists from the ballot! The American people cannot stomach any more political theater. Let’s put the findings from the hearings into action and make sure Trump and his minions are disqualified from seeking re-election! [ ]SIGN OUR PETITION ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] BIG TECH: CALL SENATORS Two bills to bust up Big Tech monopoly power are heading to the Senate - and our voices can tip the scales to get them passed. And, we need YOU to make a quick call to your Senators and join our call team reaching out to others to do the same! Our Revolution phone banker Amanda Walker is from Washington State, home to Big Tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon, and she is living the effects of concentrated corporate power and wealth. “It’s not necessarily making life easier for the rest of us,” Amanda told us. “The rent is soaring, and it’s getting harder to live here. So I called my senators, and now I’m making calls to other people asking them to do the same.” [ ]CALL YOUR SENATORS NOW! And, join our Phonebank Force to help Amanda spread the word below! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] As our movement is showing with primary victories, we can overcome the force of big money with our direct voter outreach. We have a shot to elect more allies and replace more #ManchinDems in these pivotal elections — IF we do the work! It feels great to change a voter’s mind in real-time and know that you helped get an amazing candidate into power. Help us make calls for Our Revolution candidates on the ballot in the coming weeks like Alexi Giannoulias for IL Secretary of State, congressional candidates Andy Levin (MI-11), Brittany Ramos DeBarros (NY-11), and David Segal (RI-2). [ ]SIGN UP TO MAKE CALLS ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Sign up for phone banking as we organize to re-elect one of our best allies - US Rep. Andy Levin to Congress. We will be calling thousands of Our Revolution supporters in Michigan’s 11th congressional district, which includes Detroit area communities such as Bloomfield and Pontiac. I'm angry, friend
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15740?t=6&akid=3456%2E878179%2EtkcmZQ) I'm angry, friend – but sadly, I'm not surprised: **The U.S. Supreme Court just upended nearly half a century of precedent by overturning _Roe v. Wade._** The votes of five hard-line conservatives just eviscerated reproductive freedom for at least 32 million women across the country.

To all of you out there who are shocked, angry, scared – please know that I feel your pain. I hear your anxiety. And that is why I say: **This fight is not over. We will NOT go back.**

We will not go back to a time when women were treated as second-class citizens. We will not go back to a time when personal health care decisions were made for us by politicians like Marco Rubio. We will not go back to a time when women died because they didn't have the basic human right of deciding when to start their own family.

Friend, the right-wing justices on the Supreme Court just did what GOP politicians like Marco Rubio have been pushing for for decades. **Now, we can only safeguard reproductive freedom if we expand our Democratic majority and codify the protections of Roe v. Wade into law.** [**So today I'm asking you to turn your anger into action. Guarantee an expanded Democratic majority by donating to help me defeat Marco Rubio here in Florida. Whatever you can split between Voter Protection Project and my campaign at this urgent moment will ensure our grassroots campaign has the resources to send a pro-choice woman to the Senate and show extremist Marco Rubio the door. Please donate now.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15740?t=7&akid=3456%2E878179%2EtkcmZQ) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Val Demings and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15741?t=8&akid=3456%2E878179%2EtkcmZQ)

We have witnessed years and years of coordinated Republican-led assaults on reproductive freedom that culminated in today's decision by the Supreme Court. It's a sad, dark day for our country. I am determined to not go back – but I need you and your determination alongside me. Let's flip this seat blue, expand our majority and codify Roe into law.

Thank you so much,

Beating Mike DeWine is now more important than ever before.

Folks,
Friday’s Supreme Court decision overturning _Roe v. Wade_ was a blow for reproductive rights all over the country, including here in Ohio – because now, Governor Mike DeWine and his Republican allies in the state legislature are cleared to pursue their extreme, anti-choice agenda.
Ohioans agree: Politicians have no business making personal medical decisions like these. But with new restrictions already introduced in the Ohio state legislature, we can’t leave this up to them to ensure that Ohio remains a pro-choice state.
**We must elect a governor who will defend reproductive rights.**
**[I’m running to be that governor and to ensure that abortion remains legal in Ohio. But I need your help to defeat Governor DeWine. Will you pitch in to my campaign right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46980212/352557509/-320037227?refcode=nw_em_220625_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTA3YWYzYi1jYmY0LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M2LKG3Pb9HQ9rqghX91_nfS2QmRDNsy9SVN_WRywBAw=)**
The right to access safe, legal abortion was established long ago, and I’ve fought to ensure that abortion care remains accessible in Ohio: As mayor of Dayton, I worked with community leaders, doctors, and lawyers to ensure that a local clinic was able to stay open and operational in order to provide care.
That’s the kind of work we need all across the state: measures to ensure that the full range of reproductive care is accessible for all – not politicians like Mike DeWine inserting themselves into personal medical decisions.
I pledge that I will never waiver on my commitment to protecting abortion access and reproductive freedom in Ohio, because that’s what Ohioans want and deserve.

name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Join us! Participate PA series: Supporting Progressive Candidates
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

We've seen the damage that's caused when progressive candidates don't win, but many organizations can't actually critique or support candidates specifically. That's why we're hosting Participate PA: Supporting Progressive Candidates.

We will take a deep dive into the 203 PAC, a nonpartisan group that's able to call out candidates and is working to make changes to the PA House and enable all the organizations working on progressive issues to win.

Join us on Wednesday, June 29, 2022 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM
RSVP TODAY! [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/progressive-candidates]

The 203 PAC focuses on three issues: procedural rules, a citizen's redistricting commission, and campaign finance. It partners with organizations that can also call out specific elected officials who will actually represent Pennsylvanians. As a PAC, they can criticize or praise current legislators and candidates. They can be the "muscle" that takes out a few key leaders that gives pause to those threatening our democracy, while encouraging those who have been in the trenches for years.

On our panel is Cindy Purvis who founded the 203 PAC, and is also a founding member and former president of Health Care 4 All PA, first vice chair of the Erie County Democratic Party, and a member of Democratic State Committee. As well as Rebecca Pruveadenti, a lifelong activist, supporter of progressive candidates, and former board member for Health Care 4 All PA and NW PA NOW.
Please stay connected on other upcoming events by bookmarking this page on the entire Participate PA series. [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events]

We would also like to thank the folks at Gun Owners for Safety, author Ryan Busse, Squirrel Hill Stands, and Center that Cares for last Thursday's event on the gun industry. We had a wonderful discussion and left with much to consider.

We'll see you on Wednesday for another enriching exploration of a necessary topic!

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

https://www.facebook.com/KPEdFund/ [https://www.facebook.com/KPEdFund/]

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: The loss of Roe is only the beginning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=SdfbZOX%2FekEZcmGOiP3PAMmPG6Z4eAfF&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
The U.S. Supreme Court just stripped women of their freedom to make their own private and personal healthcare decisions - and they handed that power to the government. American women no longer have the same control over their bodies as American men.
Forgive me for being dire, Friend, but if conservative justices on the Supreme Court have their way, this is only the beginning.
The concurring dissent from right-wing Justice Clarence Thomas should be a clarion call to Americans everywhere: _He said the Supreme Court should also reconsider the rulings that protect contraception, same-sex relationships, and same-sex marriage._
**In America, a woman now has no federal right to decide when and whether to bear children - and in the near future, the private and personal decisions of when to start a family or whom to love and marry may also be dictated by conservatives zealots in government.**
Yesterday's ruling overturning _Roe v. Wade_ is not a sudden, conservative-led action. This is the result of a _decades-long_ , coordinated effort on the part of the Republican Party to usurp control of our most personal freedoms. They achieved it by building political power, and they will usher in even greater harm if they take back Senate control: Mitch McConnell has already indicated that a national ban on abortion is on the table. He has already said he will block all nominations of justices to the Supreme Court for the remainder of the Biden presidency.
Yesterday, President Biden spoke to the American people and said, "Personal freedoms are on the ballot. The right to liberty, privacy, equality - they are all on the ballot." I'm asking you to heed his call. I'm asking you to prevent an anti-woman, anti-equality Republican Party from taking back control of Washington. **[Please, make a grassroots contribution of whatever you can spare right now, and your support will go toward protecting this must-win Senate seat in Connecticut, and to ensuring Senate control stays with Democrats. At moments like this, it is beyond urgent that top Democrats like you dig deep and give whatever you can to fight back.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1209-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
You have my word, Friend: I remain committed to doing whatever it takes to protect every American's right to decide whether and when to have children. I co-authored the Women's Health Protection Act, and led the effort to codify _Roe_ 's protections into federal law in the Senate, and I will not give up. We must all fight together now to protect our freedom as Americans. Thank you for fighting alongside me and doing your part.
- Sen. Richard Blumenthal
[ ](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1209-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)

Peter Willis, the task before us now is to unrig the Supreme Court. In the fallout of a decades-long push to hijack the Supreme Court and pack it with a conservative supermajority, we are now living in a nation ruled by the _Citizens United_ decision that opened the floodgates for big money in politics, and where our fundamental rights protected by _Roe v. Wade_ have been stripped away. The reality is this Supreme Court is just getting started. If we fail to act NOW, the conservative Court will continue gutting reproductive, voting, LGBTQ+, and labor rights. Justice Clarence Thomas already said the Court should reconsider rulings that protect contraception, same-sex relationships, and same-sex marriage. **We can’t wait a generation to replace these justices. That’s why Congress must exercise its constitutional authority to rebuild the integrity of a broken institution and expand the Court.** This should not be controversial. The Supreme Court has been rebalanced _**seven times**_ before. **But I am the only candidate in this race demanding that we expand the Court.** We are in times that call for the strength of will to stand up and fight for bold change. # It's time to reverse the massive crime spree
We have a serious crime problem in Chicago. Even suburban residents in places like DuPage and Will Counties are suffering. And it’s all thanks to the likes of George Soros and his hand-picked prosecutor Kim Foxx.

I teamed up with former New York City Police Commissioner Bernard Kerik to form the Kaspar/Kerik Public Safety Task Force. Working with America's Crimefighter Bernard Kerik, we’re going to bring solutions that will result in lower crime and safer communities.

This is why I am asking for your vote in the June 28th 6th Congressional District Primary so I can take these ideas to Washington to fight for you, our families and businesses.

The Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade, opening the door for Mitch McConnell to achieve his ultimate goal: banning abortion nationwide.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I really need you if we’re going to hold this seat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
I’ll be honest, I never thought this is how it’d go. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46981609/352563300/1927938479?refcode=220625_MK_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YzZjMzM3My1kNGY0LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q1QsOePjOgRb1SZ6enA03E9_1fH6jrdAO2l1DRTMpcs=)
Friends — I’ll be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go. When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out. I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family, and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get. I never thought more than 1 million people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me. And I never thought that I’d need to ask supporters to do more than that to defend this seat. But I need to ask you to do more. Friend -- As I'm sure you know, most congressional districts are safe -- meaning that one party is essentially guaranteed to win the seat, no matter how extreme that party's nominee is. And that makes it all the more important to defeat MAGA candidates in safe GOP primaries -- that's the shortest path to beating back Trump-First authoritarianism. The Country First [**ONE FUND**](https://www.country1st.com/onefund?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=one_fund_nd&n=2) benefits candidates who courageously voted in favor of impeachment and/or face a Republican primary election opponent who promotes the Big Lie that the election was stolen, amplifies dangerous conspiracy theories, and defends the January 6th attack on our Capitol. [](https://www.country1st.com/onefund?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=one_fund_nd&n=3) | [](https://www.country1st.com/onefund?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=one_fund_nd&n=4 "Invest in Democracy: Support the ONE FUND") [Invest in Democracy: Support the ONE FUND](https://www.country1st.com/onefund?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=one_fund_nd&n=4)
---
Any gift will go _directly_ to these candidates after being divided evenly, with all boats rising with each generous donation:
* **Rep. Liz Cheney** (WY), Vice Chair of the 1/6 Committee. Voted to impeach Trump following Capitol attack. Facing Trump-endorsed MAGA candidate in GOP primary.
* **Rep. Peter Meijer** (MI), voted to impeach Trump following Capitol attack. Facing Trump-endorsed MAGA candidate in GOP primary.
* **Sen. Lisa Murkowski** (AK), voted to convict Trump following Capitol attack. Facing Trump-endorsed MAGA candidate in GOP primary.
* **Rep. David Valadao** (CA), voted to impeach Trump following Capitol attack. Facing Trump-endorsed MAGA candidate in primary.
* **Clint Smith** (AZ), Independent candidate challenging Ultra-MAGA Rep. Andy Biggs.
* **Don Coram** (CO), challenging Ultra-MAGA Rep. Lauren Boebert in GOP primary.
* **Jake Hunsaker**(UT), challenging Ultra-MAGA Rep. Burgess Owens in GOP primary.
* **Matt Hausman** (IL), facing crowded field of MAGA candidates in GOP primary.

_Note: Candidates will exit the ONE FUND following their primary election. Your investment in democracy does not constitute an endorsement, or a commitment to vote for any party or candidate in November._
Let me be clear: This movement isn't aiming to elect more Republicans OR more Democrats -- we're aiming to support candidates who will preserve democracy and, with it, our republic in the face of overwhelming pressure to put party over country. America's survival doesn't rely upon giving more power to either party (as each would have us believe); [it relies upon good, reasonable people](https://www.country1st.com/onefund?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=one_fund_nd&n=5) \-- conservatives and liberals and moderates alike -- stepping up to lead, and then working together.
Thank you for being part of this important work alongside me. I couldn't do it without you -- and wouldn't want to.
Country First,
Adam

body:
The Supreme Court has officially overturned Roe v. Wade. After nearly 50 years of protection, the right to an abortion is no longer guaranteed in America.

Peter: The Supreme Court has officially overturned Roe v. Wade. **After nearly 50 years of protection, the right to an abortion is no longer guaranteed in America.**
For decades, Americans felt assured that their reproductive rights were protected. Roe was viewed by the public (and supposedly the courts) as settled and secure.

But after the Supreme Court's disastrous decision, people have ALREADY lost their right to choose an abortion in more than a dozen states, including Missouri, because of trigger laws that went into effect immediately. In Missouri, we are dealing with a total ban – women won’t even be able to get an abortion in instances of rape or incest.

**Now, this is only the beginning: Partisan extremists are already moving to tighten abortion restrictions and ban abortion in more states. Far-right senators are even discussing a _national ban._**
But this isn't over yet! We cannot give up. We are in the majority, and we must continue to speak out and demand our reproductive freedoms. **Trudy Busch Valentine is running to be a voice for safe abortion access in the Senate, and she'll work her heart out to codify Roe v. Wade into law – but to win on Election Day, she needs you with her.**
**Please, before this live opinion poll closes at 11:59 p.m. tonight, will you respond to make your voice heard for safe abortion access by telling Congress to take action?** We need another 59 people to stand with Trudy tonight, so we're really counting on your response.

| | | Dear Peter,

In the shocking and saddening decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ yesterday, the far-right conservative majority on our nation’s highest court has not only imperiled the right to safe and legal abortion care for countless millions of women across America, but also sent a clear signal to all of us that SCOTUS is just warming up when it comes to rolling back an entire generation worth of hard-earned progress toward equality under the law.

Bottom line: We need proven, experienced, pro-choice champions in Congress who are prepared to fight back and determined not to let this abomination stand.

Priority #1: Codify _Roe v. Wade_ so that women’s reproductive rights are enshrined permanently in federal law.

I am honored to be the only candidate in this race trusted to have the endorsement of _NARAL Pro-Choice America_ , one of America’s largest and most effective reproductive freedom advocacy organizations.

In the Assembly, I’ve stood up for safeguarding abortion rights, and I’m proud to have been named a _NARAL “Reproductive Freedom Leader”_ for my unwavering support for pro-choice legislation.

[I am ready to go to Congress to fight back and protect reproductive rights, just like I’ve done for a decade in the California Assembly, but I can only win with your support. Can you help me get there by sending a donation of $25, $50, or any amount before our quarterly deadline Thursday night?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=4401fd4493&e=292fde286a)

In solidarity, Kevin Mullin

name: Gavin Newsom for Governor
subject: Please give us a chance to explain
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
This is about protecting the rights of women for this generation and generations that follow.

Friends -
In just a moment, we are going to ask you to make a contribution to Gavin Newsom’s ballot measure committee to help pass a constitutional amendment in California that will further protect a woman’s right to access an abortion in California.
Please let us explain why this request — especially today — is so important.
First, let us say this: Abortion is legal in California, and it will remain that way.
Further, Governor Newsom signed a bill yesterday that makes California a safe haven for women across the nation, and we will NOT cooperate with any states attempting to prosecute women or doctors for receiving or providing reproductive care.
Now about this constitutional amendment...
If it passes in November, it will add the right to access an abortion to our state constitution, protecting the rights of women for this generation and generations that follow.
It would mean no matter what happens electorally in our state, in 2022 or any elections after, the right to choose will be enshrined in our state constitution and could not be taken away.
It will also provide a measure of protection from far-right courts and Republican legislators in Washington, D.C.
So we are going to work hard to pass this amendment, but it is not guaranteed. Nothing is guaranteed — yesterday’s opinion shows us that. But we cannot do it alone. So please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to Governor Newsom’s ballot measure committee to enshrine the right to access an abortion in California’s state constitution? name: John Fetterman
subject: Here’s what I know for sure
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I’m counting on yinz.
#
Derek,
Now that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe,_ winning PA in November has a whole new meaning.
Here’s what I know to be True:
We must expand our Senate majority.
We must end the filibuster + codify abortion rights into law.
We must defeat Dr. Oz, who would support an extreme national abortion ban (and doesn’t even live in PA, btw).
**It all comes down to flipping this seat in November.**
The thing is, we’re only five days out from a *huge* end-of-quarter FEC deadline, Derek. Soon everyone will look at our fundraising report to gauge whether we can win in Pennsylvania.
It’s honestly a make-or-break moment for our campaign, and the stakes are just too high to leave anything to chance.
[**_I’m asking for your help to reach our goal of raising $730,000 in grassroots donations before 11:59 PM on June 30. It would mean the world to me if you chipped in your very first $5 today._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220625-2?refcode=em20220625-6319&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6319_434096_CQoy89&akid=6319%2E434096%2ECQoy89)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220625-2?refcode=em20220625-6319&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6319_434096_CQoy89&akid=6319%2E434096%2ECQoy89)**
Look, this is about having the resources to beat an anti-choice extremist in one of the country’s most competitive Senate races, where our Democratic majority is on the line.
If that sounds kinda dramatic...that’s because it is! The stakes couldn’t be higher + our opponent’s got virtually unlimited money to spend.
At the same time, I know that our grassroots team is one of the strongest, like, ever. So I really think we can pull off a SUPER strong showing this quarter if everyone (including you, Derek) contributes whatever they can. 💪
It’s *especially* urgent because we need to show Dr. Oz + the GOP that we’re going to fight with everything we have, and we won’t stop until reproductive freedom is protected by law, in PA + across the nation.
[**_I hope you’ll make your first $5 donation to our campaign today. I’m asking you directly because we have less than a week to reach our end-of-quarter online fundraising goal of $730,000, and I’m counting on yinz guys to show up._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220625-2?refcode=em20220625-6319&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6319_434096_CQoy89&akid=6319%2E434096%2ECQoy89)
Thank you,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

name: Bill de Blasio
subject: Expand the Court
body:
Yesterday morning, we got the news we all feared: a majority of Supreme Court justices voted to overturn Roe v. Wade.
# [](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/201?t=1&akid=170%2E39519%2EvOK58e)

[](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/212?c0=bdb-ppny.dvM1We&refcode=em-220625&t=2&akid=170%2E39519%2EvOK58e)
Yesterday morning, we got the news we all feared: a majority of Supreme Court justices voted to overturn Roe v. Wade.
Later in the afternoon, I joined thousands of New Yorkers marching in Manhattan to protest the rights of women that have been stolen — stolen by our own Supreme Court.
Let’s be honest: this is a Supreme Court that does not represent the values of the vast majority of the American people.
It is a far-right court that made all women less safe yesterday, and made all of us less safe the day before with their gun ruling.
It’s time to expand the court and end this right-wing extremism.
Period.
Now, there is a time and a place for online campaign fundraising, but that time is not today.
Today, I wanted to share my views on expanding the court, and to ask you to join me in doing something very important.
[**Can you please use this link to make a contribution to Planned Parenthood of Greater New York?**](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/195?c0=bdb-ppny.JsqT4J&refcode=em-220625&t=3&akid=170%2E39519%2EvOK58e)
**[CONTRIBUTE $5 TO PLANNED PARENTHOOD NY](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/195?c0=bdb-ppny.JsqT4J&refcode=em-220625&t=4&akid=170%2E39519%2EvOK58e)**
There will be many women coming to New York from states that no longer allow abortion. Planned Parenthood can use our help. Thank you for chipping in.
In solidarity,
Bill de Blasio

De Blasio for Congress

#
The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe_ is devastating for women across this country — but nowhere more so than Texas, where Abbott’s trigger law can now go into effect, outlawing abortion with no exception for rape or incest.
We have to focus on the way we’re going to overcome this and ensure every Texas woman can make her own decisions about her own body, her own health care, and her own future.
**The only way to do this is to win political power.** We must win on the night of November 8th.

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek, this is
Lauren Groh-Wargo, Stacey Abrams' campaign manager.

I know that people in Georgia are feeling so many different emotions in
response to the Supreme Court’s decision to strike down a woman’s right to
choose.

As for me, I’m livid but laser focused.

As Stacey’s campaign manager, I have the privilege to get angry about
yesterday’s decision and do something about it. So let me tell you exactly
why I’m so mad — [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B2_Roe_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=752%2E1862389%2Ebzhkcr ]and why it’s more important than ever that our
grassroots supporters invest in our fight to protect reproductive rights
in Georgia.

Let me tell you a little bit about the extremist Brian Kemp — Georgia’s
current, dangerous governor:

* Kemp has been ruthless in rolling back reproductive rights since he
took office and is proud of taking rights away from our women.
* He bragged on the campaign trail about signing “the toughest abortion
bill in the country” in 2019, which makes it a crime to seek an
abortion after six weeks of pregnancy — before many women even know
they’re pregnant.
* He has been vocal in his support for ending abortion rights entirely.
* And he has indicated he may enact even stricter laws, that make all
abortion illegal and charge women and doctors with crimes.

Derek, right
now Georgia faces two paths. If Brian Kemp is re-elected, he will no
longer be accountable to Georgians, and there’s no telling how much
farther he will push his extreme, anti-abortion agenda.

But if we elect Stacey Abrams, we will have a leader in Georgia who will
defend the right to an abortion, protect women’s reproductive rights and
stand up for the rights of all Georgians.

So yes, I’m mad. But in moments like these, it’s more important than ever
that we all remember why we are in this fight — and the millions of
Georgians who are counting on us to win.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B2_Roe_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=752%2E1862389%2Ebzhkcr ]So Derek,
will you join us today? Chip in to power Stacey Abrams’ campaign right
now, and with your help, we can win in November and protect reproductive
rights from dangerous extremists like Brian Kemp.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220625_B2_Roe_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=752%2E1862389%2Ebzhkcr ]DONATE

Thank you,
Derek, for being in this fight
with us.

subject: The First Amendment and school choice
body:
Parents seek educational options without the presence of Critical Race Theory and inappropriate sexual indoctrination curriculums.

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049

** Good news from the courts
------------------------------------------------------------

** The First Ammendment and Religious Freedom Prevail
------------------------------------------------------------

The SCOTUS Blog (June 21, 2022) reported on Carson v. Makin (https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/cases/carson-v-makin/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049) , in “Court strikes down Maine’s ban on using public funds at religious schools.” (https://www.scotusblog.com/2022/06/court-strikes-down-maines-ban-on-using-public-funds-at-religious-schools/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049)

“The Supreme Court on Tuesday ruled that Maine violated the Constitution when it refused to make public funding available for students to attend schools that provide religious instruction. The opinion (https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/21pdf/20-1088_dbfi.pdf?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049) by Chief Justice John Roberts was a broad ruling, making clear that when state and local governments choose to subsidize private schools, they must allow families to use taxpayer funds to pay for religious schools.”

“The dispute before the court in https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/cases/carson-v-makin/Carson?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049 v. Makin began as a challenge to the system that Maine uses to provide a free public education to school-aged children. In some of the state’s rural and sparsely populated areas, school districts opt not to run their own secondary schools. Instead, they choose one of two options: sending students to other public or private schools that the district designates, or paying tuition at the public or private school that each student selects. But in the latter case, state law allows government funds to be used only at schools that are nonsectarian – that is, schools that do not provide religious instruction.”

“Two Maine families went to court, arguing that the exclusion of schools that provide religious instruction violates the First Amendment’s free exercise clause (https://constitutioncenter.org/interactive-constitution/interpretation/amendment-i/interps/265?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=651153c04c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_24_06_55_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-651153c04c-584862049) . On Tuesday, the justices agreed.”

As your next Governor, I will support the First Amendment and school choice. Parents seek educational options without the presence of Critical Race Theory and inappropriate sexual indoctrination curriculums. The Supreme Court affirmed using taxpayer funds for religious schools.

** We are heading into a war with POLIS.
------------------------------------------------------------

We are going to need an ARMY of volunteers and donors to win this battle:

Makin () , in “Court strikes down Maine’s ban on using public funds at religious schools.” () “The Supreme Court on Tuesday ruled that Maine violated the Constitution when it refused to make public funding available for students to attend schools that provide religious instruction. The opinion () by Chief Justice John Roberts was a broad ruling, making clear that when state and local governments choose to subsidize private schools, they must allow families to use taxpayer funds to pay for religious schools.” “The dispute before the court in v. Makin began as a challenge to the system that Maine uses to provide a free public education to school-aged children. In some of the state’s rural and sparsely populated areas, school districts opt not to run their own secondary schools. Instead, they choose one of two options: sending students to other public or private schools that the district designates, or paying tuition at the public or private school that each student selects. But in the latter case, state law allows government funds to be used only at schools that are nonsectarian – that is, schools that do not provide religious instruction.” “Two Maine families went to court, arguing that the exclusion of schools that provide religious instruction violates the First Amendment’s free exercise clause () . body:
With recent polling shows this race tied, North Carolina is our best hope to expand the majority, end the filibuster and protect our rights. A small number of votes in North Carolina could decide whether we expand the majority so Cheri can cast the decisive vote to codify abortion rights, act on climate change, defend voting rights, and more.
[**Please consider making a donation today to elect Cheri to the U.S. Senate to fight for our rights and the future we deserve — one where each of us has the chance to thrive.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220625-2-ma&refcode2=1117.357359.VRVFbp&t=1&akid=1117%2E357359%2EVRVFbp)

[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220625-2-ma&refcode2=1117.357359.VRVFbp&t=2&akid=1117%2E357359%2EVRVFbp)
The Supreme Court just ruled to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.
It is the terrifying and dangerous moment that so many of us have warned was coming, and once again, Washington is failing to protect our rights.
Too many Senators lack the courage to fight for our rights. So our only option, if we are going to codify the right to reproductive freedom for every woman in this country, is to mobilize in the most competitive races where we expand our Senate majority.
North Carolina is one of our best chances to do that, and I promise that if you help me flip this seat, I will not hesitate to be the 51st vote to end the filibuster and codify abortion rights into law.
[**If you want to see real change and progress in the U.S. Senate, please make a donation today to help us flip North Carolina and expand our majority. A 50/50 Senate is not working for our families, so it’s our job to change it.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220625-2-ma&refcode2=1117.357359.VRVFbp&t=3&akid=1117%2E357359%2EVRVFbp)

As former Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I want to be 100% clear: reproductive freedom is a constitutional right.

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: It’s official, Roe v. Wade has been overturned
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15780?t=6&akid=3473%2E878179%2E4iGJbs) It’s official: Roe v. Wade has been overturned by the U.S. Supreme Court.

It’s been a hard few weeks since this decision was leaked, but now it’s real — and I’m sure you’re angry, frustrated, and scared about what this means. I am too.

**But this decision means the next Governor will have the ability to sign — or veto — that legislation. I will veto any bill that restricts a woman’s right to choose — and with this news, we know that’s going to be one of the most consequential decisions our next Governor makes.**

[**We must win this race to keep abortion safe, legal, and accessible in Pennsylvania. It is literally up to us. Can you donate whatever feels right to you in this moment to help defend reproductive rights in Pennsylvania and Voter Protection Project?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15780?t=7&akid=3473%2E878179%2E4iGJbs) You probably know a grandparent, aunt, parent, sibling, or even yourself who marched for the right to choose fifty years ago, before Roe v. Wade became the law of the land.

I’ve met people who marched back then — people who are furious and tired that they have to do this all over again for something they thought was set in stone — a right that we all thought would be protected forever.

I want you to know that I’m furious too. That I will not ever back down from protecting the right to choose in Pennsylvania — from protecting women’s lives.

Due to the Supreme Court’s decision, each and every state will decide whether the women who reside there can have an abortion.

So with a Republican Legislature that’s tried time and time again to restrict abortion access (even through a constitutional amendment), we can be certain they’ll send a bill severely limiting abortion access in Pennsylvania to the desk of the next Governor.

[**Know this: abortion remains legal in Pennsylvania — and will remain legal if I’m elected Governor. Can you donate $5 or whatever you can today to elect a pro-choice Governor in Pennsylvania and Voter Protection Project?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15780?t=8&akid=3473%2E878179%2E4iGJbs) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Shapiro and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15781?t=9&akid=3473%2E878179%2E4iGJbs)

Together, we can do this.

Josh Shapiro

body:
The Supreme Court has ruled that reproductive health care is no longer
federally protected and will now be decided by the individual states.

In Texas, Greg Abbott has already signed a “trigger law” that criminalizes
all abortion — with no exception for rape or incest — and can now go into
effect following yesterday’s decision.

That means that in a matter of weeks, no woman will have control over her
body in Texas, a state that already struggles to ensure proper medical
care for women and girls and which leads much of the developed world in
the rate of maternal mortality. More women face this unprecedented attack
on their freedom and their health in Texas than in any other state in
America.

So it’s on us to respond and to act. That means standing
up to Abbott and fighting for Texas women by winning this election for
governor.

Imagine the impact that will have not only in Texas, but across the
country.

The state that came up with this “trigger law,” the state that has been
leading the attack on a woman’s right to choose for over a decade, and the
state that promised bounty hunters $10,000 to turn in those who helped
women get an abortion can be the state that elects a governor who will
work to ensure that every woman makes her own decisions about her own body
and her own future.

Let’s use these next days — between yesterday’s decision and the
implementation of Abbott’s total abortion ban — to assemble the volunteers
and raise the resources we need to win political power. Do not succumb to
the temptation to despair or give up in the face of this attack. Turn your
anger into action and focus on what will do the greatest good.

The only way to overcome this attack on women and reproductive freedom is
to win this election.

The only way to win this election is with your help.
